name: ford_circles

phase_0.boundary_condition: The x-axis serving as the baseline where all Ford circles are tangent, containing the entire system of circles above it.

VINIT.justification: Initial void state before any circles exist.

TANCH.justification: Fixed boundary containing all circles, each tangent to this baseline.

AFWD.justification: Forward transformation mapping a fraction to its Ford circle geometry.

AREV.justification: Reverse operation decomposing a fraction into its two parent fractions via the mediant inverse.

CLINK.justification: Chaining consecutive Farey sequence fractions to generate new mediants.

IMSCRIB.justification: Each circle uniquely self-identifies through its defining fraction.

FSPLIT.justification: Splits a generated fraction into its two parent fractions.

FFUSE.justification: Fuses two adjacent fractions into their mediant child fraction.

EVALT.justification: Affirms a fraction is reduced, permitting circle generation.

EVALF.justification: Negative branch for non-reduced fractions, unused in Farey sequence generation.

ENGAGR.justification: Paradice state where a circle is simultaneously tangent to left and right neighbors.

IFIX.justification: Permanent record of a circle added to the set.

phase_3.void_description: No circles exist; only the x-axis boundary is present.
phase_3.true_description: A circle is successfully generated and added to the set.
phase_3.false_description: A fraction fails reduction check; unused in canonical generation.
phase_3.both_description: A circle exists in tangency to both adjacent neighbors simultaneously.

steps.domain_action: Initialize void state with no circles.
Establish x-axis boundary and seed initial fractions 0/1 and 1/1.
Permanently add circle 0/1 to the set.
Permanently add circle 1/1 to the set.
Self-reference to current Farey sequence state [0/1, 1/1].
Prepare to extend sequence by processing pair (0/1, 1/1).
Compute mediant of 0/1 and 1/1 to form fraction 1/2.
Verify 1/2 is reduced (always true in Farey sequence).
Circle 1/2 achieves simultaneous tangency to neighbors 0/1 and 1/1.
Permanently add circle 1/2 to the set.
Decompose fraction 1/2 into parent fractions 0/1 and 1/1.
Chain to next Farey sequence extension point.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Mathematical definitions of Ford circles and mediant operations.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Geometric constraints determining circle positions and tangency.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Immutable set of generated circles stored by fraction.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Farey sequence order: increasing denominators with sorted numerators.
phase_5.alfs_store: Initial fractions 0/1 and 1/1 as bootstrap elements.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Computational resources for circle generation and mediant calculations.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Current set of circles in Farey sequence.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Set expanded with new circle from mediant operation.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — Reversible via fraction decomposition; total information conserved.
